newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products firmer across the barrel.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products firmer across the barrel.

text.p: NWE oil products were firmer across the barrel with crude on Wednesday.
Gasoline pushed higher with winter specification Eurograde barges done at $214, summer grade at $213, $214 and $215 fob ARA.
Naphtha was steady to firmer amid relaxed end-user demand.
Gas oil gained $3 a tonne on the back of sharply higher futures and holding premiums, but activity was slow.
Cracked fuel oil prices were mostly firmer in line with crude, but high sulphur barges, trading $3 higher, continued to get extra lift from cargo pricing.
